pick.name: Granola
pick.why: No bot joins the call; suits sensitive prospects

best_free.name: Fathom
best_free.what: AI notetaker for Zoom, Meet and Teams
best_free.why: Free unlimited recordings, transcripts and summaries
best_free.free_limits: Free: unlimited recordings; Premium USD 16/mo annual

alts.name: Otter.ai
alts.what: Mature transcription with a free Basic plan (300 min/user/mo, 30 min per conversation); Pro USD 8.33/user/mo annual or USD 16.99 monthly

decision: Fathom covers the three main meeting platforms for free. Use Granola when a prospect objects to bots. Always announce recording, and never record PHI-bearing calls without a BAA.
note: One answer across the site: Granola for notes without a bot joining the call, Fathom's free plan when budget is zero. For calls with health or other regulated data, record only with consent, using a local tool.
details: best_free set to null: Fathom's free plan is the best free option. Granola moved to alts (bot-free, free plan keeps 30 days of history; Business USD 14/user/mo).

region_notes.EU: Recording needs notice and a lawful basis under GDPR.

verify.note: Fathom Free verified: unlimited recordings + transcriptions, instant AI summaries (some AI features 'limited use'); Premium USD 20 monthly / USD 16 annual, Team USD 15 annual (2-user min), Business USD 25 annual.
